_readme: Every studio fact the website and booking use lives here. null = not supplied by the client yet; the site hides it. Fields under _confirm still need the client's sign-off.
name: Lash by Design

services.name: Classic full set
services.blurb: One extension on each natural lash. Clean, defined and natural, like your lashes on their best day.

services.name: Hybrid full set
services.blurb: Classic lashes mixed with soft volume fans. Texture and fullness without going all the way.

services.name: Volume full set
services.blurb: Featherlight handmade fans on every lash for a full, fluffy, statement look.

services.name: Infill
services.blurb: Every 2 to 3 weeks, we replace the lashes you've naturally shed so your set stays full.

services.name: Lash lift and tint
services.blurb: Your own lashes, lifted and darkened. No extensions, no upkeep, lasting about six to eight weeks.
